en: A black‑and‑white view of a grand Neo‑Renaissance building with two domed corner towers and a richly decorated façade, fronted by a large open square. In the foreground is a circular fountain with an expressive sculptural group of intertwined human figures, surrounded by curved steps and low concrete benches where people sit and relax. Pedestrians walk across the spacious plaza; surrounding the main building are other late‑19th‑century urban buildings.
